key_insight: HealthAgentBench is a 54-task healthcare benchmark that tests whether AI agents can handle realistic, end-to-end clinical workflows rather than simple prompts.
clinical_relevance: It highlights that current frontier agents still struggle with complex healthcare tasks, with the best system reaching only about 42% success, so deployment readiness remains limited.
method: Built 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories
Each task uses its own realistic environment and multi-step workflow
Evaluated frontier agents on a single overall task success metric
evidence_signal: The benchmark spans diverse patient-journey workflows and modalities, and the strongest reported agent, Codex GPT-5.5, achieved roughly 42% success overall.
watch_item: Results come from benchmark environments, so strong performance here does not by itself prove safe or reliable use in real clinical settings.
paper_title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
